title: Every n-dimensional subspace of R^(n+l) is a rotated coordinate plane
statement: For all natural numbers n, l and every linear subspace T of R^(n+l) = Amb n l with dim T = n, there is a linear isometry equivalence q of R^(n+l) with rotatedPlane q = T, where rotatedPlane q = (horizontalPlane n l).map q and horizontalPlane n l = span{EuclideanSpace.single (Fin.castAdd l i) 1 : i < n} = R^n x {0}.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), Module.finrank ℝ T = n → ∃ q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ, rotatedPlane q = T
